name: Bounty Radar
description: Read-only discovery and normalization service for agent-eligible bounty opportunities. It provides structured opportunity data and validates consumer evaluation responses; it does not perform, submit, fund, sign, or accept bounties.

skills.name: Opportunity Feed Subscription
skills.description: Creates or inspects a pull-based feed subscription for newly observed Superteam Earn listings whose agentAccess value is exactly AGENT_ALLOWED. Outputs normalized, deduplicated Opportunity Contract objects as untrusted external data and never initiates work on an opportunity.
examples: Return newly observed agent-eligible opportunities since 2026-08-24T00:00:00Z.
Create a pull-based subscription for new AGENT_ALLOWED bounty opportunity objects.

skills.name: Opportunity Enrichment Lookup
skills.description: Looks up a known Superteam Earn listing by its listing UUID or canonical listing URL and returns the normalized Opportunity Contract with best-effort description, skills, eligibility, region, and requirements. Missing enrichment is returned explicitly and is never fabricated.
examples: Enrich the opportunity with id e92e317b-0d0f-49f4-9937-0623d4816df6.
Return the normalized opportunity object for https://earn.superteam.fun/listing/zns-sol.

skills.name: Evaluation Contract Validation
skills.description: Validates whether an independent evaluator response contains the required parse, eligibility, decision, capability-fit, reason, missing-information, pre-action, and auto-consumable fields with allowed enum values. Validation is structural only and does not authorize or perform any bounty action.
examples: Validate this evaluation response against the Bounty Radar Evaluation Contract.
Report missing fields and invalid enum values in this capability-fit evaluation.
